tag.description: A woman in her late twenties with shoulder-length wavy auburn hair, a navy and white striped Breton shirt, light blue jeans and white sneakers.
A man in his early thirties with short dark curly hair and a trimmed beard, a light denim jacket over a white t-shirt, dark chinos and brown boots.
A heavyset man in his fifties with short grey hair and round glasses, a light blue button-down shirt and beige trousers.
A young athletic woman in her twenties with a sleek black bob, a beige trench coat over a black turtleneck, black trousers and loafers.
A classic Parisian café front in dark green painted wood, gold lettering reading CAFÉ above tall glass doors and windows, warm light inside.

renders.look: A sunny Parisian café terrace in the morning, a café front with a striped awning. Mia is a woman in a striped shirt sipping coffee, Sam is a man in a denim jacket talking to her, Ray is a man in a blue shirt reading a book at the next table, Zoe is a young woman in a beige trench coat walking past while looking at her phone. Warm sunlight, cinematic street photography.

settings.prompt: Render @frame as a finished image. Keep its exact composition: the camera, the framing, and every person and object where they are and posed as they are. Each coloured clay mannequin becomes the real character described for it, with natural skin, hair and clothes: its colour only tells it apart and is not its skin or its clothing, and none stays a mannequin. In the frame, exactly four characters, and no one else: the red figure on the left is Mia: Mia is a woman in a striped shirt sipping coffee; the turquoise figure in the middle, at the back is Sam: Sam is a man in a denim jacket talking to her; the yellow figure on the right, at the back is Ray: Ray is a man in a blue shirt reading a book at the next table; the purple figure on the right, in front is Zoe: Zoe is a young woman in a beige trench coat walking past while looking at her phone — with a shop facade, a striped shop awning, a round table with tablecloth, a chair, a takeaway coffee, a plate, a croissant, an a-frame menu board, a city bicycle, a street lamp. The clay blockouts become real things, with real materials, textures and light. A sunny Parisian café terrace in the morning, a café front with a striped awning. Warm sunlight, cinematic street photography.
